name: Glass Product Render
mo_ta_vi: Vật thể thuỷ tinh trong studio đen, vệt sáng quét tạo viền cầu vồng, camera trôi chậm, nhịp sáng khớp phách.
summary: Launch-film glass render: dark studio, strip-light sweeps, dispersion, caustics, slow orbits on the beat.
character: One fictional hero object of glass, metal and light floating in an infinite black studio. Strips behind it turn clear glass into a thin white outline with rainbow edges; internals show through like a display case. Slow, precise, every sweep and pulse on the beat.

palette.rule: Neutral world of black, greys and strip-light white; one accent family reserved for light only; dispersion rainbows only at thick glass edges and in caustics.

typography: Be Vietnam Pro 300 for titles, very large with wide tracking, upper third
Small tracked caps 18-20 px for kickers
Product name and claim as title cards, not caption lines
layout: One hero object, centred or on a strong diagonal, never cropped in a wide
Negative space left for type on pull-backs
Each shot is its own presentation stage; no spatial continuity needed
material: Clear glass: MeshPhysical transmission 1, roughness 0.015, IOR 1.5, dispersion on
Frosted glass only with something bright behind or inside
Satin and brushed metals; anything inside glass is opaque
texture: Black gloss floor with blurred mirror and radial fade, no horizon line
Procedural caustic rings on the floor
camera: Always drifting: slow orbits and push-ins, never locked off
Macro rack focus from shell to the part inside
Exploded view on a 40 degree axis with a slow orbit

pacing.rhythm: Slow eased moves; long ease-out apart, short drifting hover, very short ease-in snap on a downbeat.

beat_response: Light sweeps and pulses are events on the beat grid
Exploded parts snap shut on a downbeat
Two frames of micro-shake on an impact, never more
ui_choreography: No flat UI screens; data shown as light travelling inside glass
Accent line on frosted-glass caption slab
diagrams: Light paths inside channels show flow of charge, data or heat
character_motion: No characters; objects lift, hinge and settle with eased motion
captions: Frosted-glass slab: centred rounded bar of the blurred live frame, Be Vietnam Pro 300 about 40 px near-white, accent line on top
sound: Minimal electronic: glass bells, granular crystal, filtered tick grid, sub drone, soft kicks
Foley follows the material: glass shimmer per sweep, magnetic clicks, air puffs
Short total silence before a release

signature_moves: Strip-light sweep drawing a glass contour in the dark
Rack focus through glass to the part inside
Exploded view that snaps shut on a downbeat
strengths: Premium, physical product presence from code alone
Makes an invisible function visible as light
Reads instantly as a launch film
constraints: Engine is three.js with the lemo-opuscar studio rig and post stack (lemo.mjs add --style glass-product)
lemoRender(t, win) is a pure function of t; motion timed as fractions of a shot
Render is about 5 times slower than a GSAP-only composition; two renders match to PSNR 50 dB or better, not byte for byte
The object is fictional: no real product silhouette, brand, logo or UI
All Vietnamese text in the DOM layer, never in the WebGL canvas
avoid: HDRI photo studios that print clutter on glass
Dissolves, wipes and rainbow gradients on surfaces or type
